issue_context.title: AIX5.3 openssl1.1.1q ssl not work, error is wrong cipher returned
issue_context.body:
# BUG

I want to use OpenSSL 1.1.1g for SSL in AIX5.3, but ssl is not work, in my test, the newest stable version exist the same problem

## Tools
|  Name   | Value |
|  ----  | ----  |
| System  | AIX5.3 |
| Arch  | powerpc |
| Compiler  | xlc |
 
## Build
```
cmake -E tar -xf openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1q.tar.gz
perl Configure aix-cc no-shared no-unit-test
make -j4
```

## Test
```
./apps/openssl s_client -host www.infosec.com.cn -port 443
```

## Result
```
CONNECTED(00000005)
1:error:1421C105:SSL routines:set_client_ciphersuite:wrong cipher returned:ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c:1353:
```

I build OpenSSL with CFLAG "-O0", stack is work.
